name: National Benefit Brokers
imageAlt: National Benefit Brokers website shown on a desktop display
body: We partnered with National Benefit Brokers (NBBHawaii.com) to modernize and elevate their online presence as a leading provider of financial and insurance services across Hawaii and the U.S. With a clear focus on retirement income planning, protected growth, and living benefits, NBB needed a digital platform that could clearly communicate complex strategies in a way that felt approachable, trustworthy, and client-focused.

The result is a clean, modern website built for both education and conversion — featuring simplified content structure, dynamic calls to action, and an easy-to-use appointment scheduler. Clients can now explore tailored solutions for long-term care, tax-deferred income, executive benefits, and more, all backed by real-life client stories and proven strategies.

With improved user experience, better mobile responsiveness, and a strong emphasis on lead generation, NBB is now equipped with a digital platform that reflects the quality and care they’ve delivered to island families and clients nationwide since 2006.
result: Traffic increased by 51% in the first 90 days.
